title: I See
summary: A sensory exploration of sight. Simple sight words paired with evocative visual imagery to invite wonder in pre-readers.

pages.scene: A small child looking out at the world, wonder in their eyes, soft light streaming
A warm golden sun rising, painting the sky in soft oranges and pinks
A fluffy cat, soft and peaceful, with bright curious eyes
Close-up of the cat's fur, texture emphasized, whispery and gentle
A vast, dreamy sky in shades of blue and white with gentle clouds
A figure moving gracefully through a garden, flowers nodding as she passes
Child running joyfully through sunlit grass, arms open
Child and cat together, both looking at something beautiful, bathed in warm light
